title: LLM Data Guard
description: Detect and redact PII and secrets before text reaches an LLM.

texts.title: Texts
texts.description: Each entry is one document (prompt, chat message, ticket, log line, file content).

documents.title: Documents with IDs
documents.description: Optional: [{"id": "ticket-42", "text": "..."}]. The id is echoed in the output row.

documentUrls.title: Document URLs
documentUrls.description: Optional: public URLs of text, Markdown, JSON, CSV, HTML or PDF files (max 10 MB each).

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: detect = report findings only; redact = also return redacted text; restore = put original values back into LLM output using a placeholder map.

redactionStyle.title: Redaction style
redactionStyle.description: placeholder = [EMAIL_1] (reversible with the map); mask = j***@a***.com / **** 1111; hash = [EMAIL:sha256 prefix] (stable for the same salt).

returnPlaceholderMap.title: Return placeholder map
returnPlaceholderMap.description: Include {"[EMAIL_1]": "jane@acme.com"} in each row so you can restore values after the LLM answers. The map contains the original sensitive values: only enable it if you will delete the dataset after use.

consistentPlaceholders.title: Consistent placeholders across documents
consistentPlaceholders.description: Same value gets the same placeholder in every document of the run.

placeholderMap.title: Placeholder map (restore mode)
placeholderMap.description: Map returned by a previous redact run; used only in restore mode.

hashSalt.title: Hash salt
hashSalt.description: Optional salt for hash style. Leave empty for a random per-run salt (hashes then cannot be linked across runs).

detectPii.title: Detect PII
detectPii.description: Emails, phones, US SSNs, credit cards (Luhn), IBANs (mod-97), UK NI numbers, IPv4/IPv6.

detectSecrets.title: Detect secrets
detectSecrets.description: Gitleaks-style rules: AWS, GitHub, GitLab, Slack, Stripe, Google, OpenAI, Anthropic, Hugging Face, npm, SendGrid, Twilio, Azure keys, JWTs, private keys, URL credentials, key=value assignments with an entropy check.

detectNames.title: Detect person names (NER)
detectNames.description: Open-source NER (compromise, English). Lower precision; adds a little CPU time.

detectAddresses.title: Detect street addresses & places
detectAddresses.description: Street-address pattern (English formats) plus NER place names.

entropyScan.title: Flag any high-entropy string
entropyScan.description: Also flag unlabeled random-looking tokens (20+ chars). Catches unknown key formats; may flag hashes and IDs.

minEntropy.title: Minimum entropy (bits/char)
minEntropy.description: Threshold for generic key=value secrets and the entropy scan.

defaultPhoneRegion.title: Default phone region
defaultPhoneRegion.description: ISO country code used for phone numbers written without +country prefix.

entityTypes.title: Only these types
entityTypes.description: Optional filter, e.g. EMAIL, PHONE, CREDIT_CARD, AWS_ACCESS_KEY. Empty = all enabled detectors.

allowList.title: Allow list
allowList.description: Exact values never flagged (e.g. your public support@ address).

includeFindingValues.title: Include raw values in findings
includeFindingValues.description: Off by default: findings carry only a masked preview and offsets. Original values can still be stored via returnPlaceholderMap, restore mode or anything redaction misses.

maxCharsPerDocument.title: Max characters per document
maxCharsPerDocument.description: Longer documents are truncated (row gets truncated=true).

purgeInputAfterRun.title: Purge input after run
purgeInputAfterRun.description: Delete the INPUT record from the run's key-value store when the run ends, so only the results dataset remains.
